# /etc/usb16x16/aes67.conf: operating point for usb16x16-aes67.service.
#
# This is the only file an operator edits. KEY=value lines; values are bare
# tokens or double-quoted strings. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# A profile switch is a stack restart: about a minute to audio.
#
# Switch with:  sudo usb16x16-aes67-supervisor switch-profile <name>
# List with:    usb16x16-aes67-supervisor profiles

PROFILE=user-immersive-stereo-subs

# Service settings. Comments go on their own lines; a trailing comment after
# a value is a parse error and the supervisor refuses to start.
# One 1 Hz BRIDGE line in N goes to the journal.
JOURNAL_BRIDGE_EVERY=10
# /run/usb16x16/bridge.log rotates once at this size.
BRIDGE_LOG_CAP_MB=64
# More bridge direction restarts than this in 60 s restarts the stack.
RECOVER_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=5
# A RECOVER storm of this many in one second with USB input frozen means
# the host is gone: the bridge alone stops and waits (measured at the
# unplug: 33-185 in the first second).
HOST_STORM_RECOVERS_PER_SECOND=10
# With no host, try the bridge again this often, in seconds. A Mac waking
# from sleep resumes the device without re-enumerating, so this retry is
# the only wake signal; each retry costs a bridge start and a 3 s storm,
# no module churn.
HOST_RETRY_SECONDS=60

# otherwise the 2026-09-02 point; accepted 2026-09-03, bridge 0254348c.
# Four 600 s runs at 800 impulses: 25.563 ms x2, 25.813 ms, 27.313 ms, zero
# restarts, tx_qfloor 164-193 against the 144-frame skip bar, and no pull
# above 48 frames in any run.

PROFILE_SAFE_STATUS=accepted
PROFILE_SAFE_COVER="TX floor 164-193 over the 144-frame skip bar"
PROFILE_SAFE_MEASURED="25.6 ms (25.6-27.3), 4 x 800 impulses"

# term holds the differential depth where it settled. Experimental until it

# Profile: servo-aligned. Profile servo with the aligned start: the bridge
# times eight RAVENNA capture wakeups (one per driver tick), then re-prepares
# that capture ALIGN_OFFSET_US after the last one, so the reader phase the
# driver fixes at prepare is a constant rather than a per-session draw inside
# one tick. That makes the sink delay's wrap point repeatable, which is what
# lets SINK_DELAY sit inside the repeatable window instead of at 576 (0 mod

# 1501 and 1448/1472/1496, five samples apart, while 576 and 168 each flipped
# a lap between the sessions. 96 is the smallest on-line value plus the 48
# margin the rule asks for; 30.2 ms, repeatable, against the servo profile's
# 28.2-33.3 ms draw. ALIGN_START / ALIGN_OFFSET_US are optional in a block;
# absent means off / 600. Accepted 2026-09-03 on four loaded 800-impulse runs:
# 1416, 1421, 1416, 1400 samples (29.2-29.6 ms), every impulse on one
# sample, zero restarts, zero clips, TX floor 159-163, RX floor 107-133.

# the bridge's trigger and the tick grid is a per-session draw of up to 48

# playback trigger, at start and at every TX recovery, waits for the next

# rings were sized for the resampler era; with the pitch servo both

# target + 3 (131) in any of the 59 sessions and runs since the servo went

# target (64 per direction = 128 samples), so the expected level is about
# 1190 at 64 frames (24.8 ms), RTL at 32 about 28.7 ms. The thing to watch
# is the floors: that run also lost prime overshoot (TX floor 130 to 97)
# because the prime threshold is target + queue_prime + 3 and was crossed on
# a different capture phase; the aligned TX prime now sets its drop from the
# measured grid, so the floors may or may not follow. Accept only with
# tx_qfloor over the bar (about 96) and rx_qfloor 96 or better on the usual
# gate probe, four loaded 800-impulse runs and the 600 s sixteen-channel

# sd132 with SINK_DELAY=103 instead of 132, one variable, conf only, 2026-09-07,
# on module bc694c24: the rest of the free sink-delay range, priced by the
# Ferrofish stamp phase. The driver places a sink packet's first sample at
# stamp plus delay and copies it at the TIC of the 48-sample frame holding
# that position, so the delay moves the deadline only when the stream's
# grid phase plus the delay crosses a multiple of 48: for phase p every
# delay in 144 - p .. 191 - p has 144's deadline and 144 - p is the lowest
# free value. The phase read from the 2026-09-06 eth0 captures (trace1 and
# txfix, 70 minutes apart across a module reload; stage-trace-20260906/
# stamp-phase.py, evidence in stamp-phase-20260906-captures.txt) is 41 on
# every packet of the sink 0 stream (239.69.121.9): wire phase 9 against the
# Pi's own source at 16, the Pi's stamps being the TIC SAC minus one frame,
# a multiple of 48, so the difference is the phase and the 16 is the 2^32
# mod 48 shift of the SAC high word (it moves 16 every 24.855 h on the wire
# and cancels in the difference). Sink 1 (239.69.193.115) was not in those
# captures; its lead has read within 5-25 us of sink 0's on every interval at
# 144 and at 132, which puts its phase within a sample of 41. Hence 103: 29
# samples under 132, 41 under 144, 0.604 ms, with the deadline of 144 and
